Title: Liberalism and the Limits of Justice
Author: Michael Sandel
My Review: The self behind the veil of ignorance is unencumbered, prior to its ends and its community. No one is like that, so justice cannot be prior to the good. The communitarian critique of Rawls and the original position.

Title: After Virtue
Author: Alasdair MacIntyre
My Review: Modern moral argument is fragments of a lost tradition of the virtues. Justice needs a shared account of the good of a community; both Rawls and Nozick leave out desert because liberal individualism has no place for it.

Title: Spheres of Justice
Author: Michael Walzer
My Review: Different social goods are distributed by different principles, each from the shared meanings of a community. Complex equality, against one principle of justice for everything.

Title: A Theory of Justice
Author: John Rawls
My Review: The original position, the veil of ignorance, equal basic liberties and the difference principle. Justice as fairness.

Title: Sources of the Self
Author: Charles Taylor
My Review: The modern identity and its moral sources. The self is constituted in a community and a language of goods, not prior to them.

Title: Nicomachean Ethics
Author: Aristotle
My Review: The virtues, practical wisdom, and justice as a virtue of character and of the political community.
